title: The Ego Loves Dirtiness
body:
(Mawlana stands.)
As-salamu `alaykum! By the name of Allah Almighty, Most Merciful, Most Beneficent, Most Munificent! May
Allah grant you from His endless blessings to be His honored servants. All of us are servants who are living
on Earth; if they are accepting or not, they are the Lord's servants.We are saying a`oodhu billahi min ashShaytaani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. Yaa Rabbana lakal hamd! May Allah grants us for
the honor of the most beloved one in His Divinely Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s) (Mawlana sits.)
[ ...video cut...] Dhul Qa'adah that it has special honor for the Ummah, as Allah Almighty honoring months
Dhul Qa`dah ... Muharram and also Rajab ... and all of us are servants. Some people they are accepting their
servanthood, but most people they are not thinking on it. They are thinking that they are something. The
Lord of Servanthood going to be a heaviness on their shoulders and it is opposite to be our Lord's servants.
(There is) no any other high honor or glory for Mankind. But people now they are drunk. When a person
going to be drunk, that level going to be under the level of animals. Animals are knowing they have been
created for Mankind by the Lord of Heavens-- they know it! But mostly now on Earth they are never thinking,
or they are thinking but not accepting to be servants of the Lord of Heavens.

Whoever is accepting they have been given honor, and whom they are not accepting, no honor for them; they
are losing servanthood. Over everything, Lordship is only for Allah, for the Creator. Everything that is in
existence, He is creating and giving them some work or something to do. Nothing is created without a
meaning, without a responsibility, or without a wisdom. Nothing created. Every creature they are knowing
this, only Man that they are drunk now, they are so proud and not accepting. Accepting or not, if they are
accepting they are reaching an honor, if not accepting they are losing their honors and no value for them in
the Divinely Presence.
Allah Almighty making a Preserved Tablet, Lawhi 'l-Mahfoozh. Written on it everything about this world and
who is on it, what they are going to do or what they must do, and sending Man to be His deputies on this
planet. Don't think Allah Almighty has only one dunya, one planet. Through His dominions there are
countless creations. Creation is running, running and not stopping. He is Creator from pre-Eternal up to
Eternal. No one is knowing what is pre-Eternal and no one knowing what is Eternal. And written this is only
one spot through His endless territories. He is looking after His Creation, but He is looking is so high, can't
carry His looking anything, only His deputy representing Him Almighty. That is knowledge reaching to whole
prophets, messengers and their inheritors; no common people may understand. Whom they are running
through sewage channels are not understanding, and people now mostly are running through sewage
channels. Their lives are dirty. Dirty! But Shaytan making them believe that your their is the high life!
Because our egos are dirty and it is in such a position that it likes only dirtiness. Inna 'n-nafsa la-ammaaratan
bi 's-soow. Everything that it is doing is dirty, therefore our egos asking dirtiness.
Now look at people, where are they living, what are their levels? They are saying "this is high life," or they are
saying they are most civilized people. What you will find when you are making a research is that their lives
are through dirtiest channels. And they are like big rats that they are enjoying through sewage channels. If
you are saying, "Come out," they are not coming. If you are coming outside our atmosphere is best one; come
and clean yourself. We are only looking at our lives....that is the only common check up that I can do, that is
for me to make a research and give my report to heavens then coming on them something!
Dirtiness is not an honor for honored deputies of the Lord of Heavens. A`oodhu billah! We are asking not to
fall on same sewage channels. You can't take them out. Now from east to west or north to south, they are
insisting to be in that dirty sewage channels. Therefore, we are asking democracy, for that reason they are

fighting to each other. Some of them are saying they are in small lake and you are in big oceans for what?
Give our rights also, more dirtiness from your sewage channels comes on us a little bit more. (Mawlana
laughs.) They are happy.
Therefore, the Prophet was saying, "O our Lord, don't leave beings to follow the ways of dirtiness sewage
channels; keep us." One second you may fall in it, then falling in it you can't be able to save yourself. O
People! Look where you are living 24 hours where you are living, a clean life or dirty life? Your Lord should
punish you! And I am running to my Lord not to be of those people. May Allah forgive us and send us
someone that can cut sewage channels from up, not to come through those channels. First going to be dried
that channels, then they are asking, "Where?" and not finding, then they are asking to get out. As long as that
sewage channels running, they are not getting out! Therefore, now we are looking that you can't find anyone
that never touched from that dirtiness. If a heavy raining coming as much as we can carry an umbrella, but if
something coming on you.... Shaytan making so many channels for men and for women. I am the weakest
servant. In my old age, I have been appointed to address to people from east to west and I am running from
my ego's dirtiness.
O People! We are calling you to a clean life. Accept it! It is good for you; if you are not accepting, not coming
only pig flu but may come elephant flu also! What we shall do? (Laughter) May come chimpanzee flu! I hope
to come dog's flu! I shall pray two rakats if coming that dog's flu because they are putting dogs (to their face).
Man is now becoming slaves or servants to dogs--what is that? That is their top point of their civilization?
Everyone after himself carrying small one, big one, black one, red one, green one...some people saying, "I am
painting my dog to be seen green dog." And I am asking from my Lord, "O my Lord send to those people who
they are going to be servants of dogs, send to them dog's flu! Ohhhh, I shall slaughter seven bulls (as qurban).
(Laughter) They should be very angry! Eh angry-mangry, I am making du'a, "O Lord, send to those people
who going to be servants to dogs, but not accepting to be Your servants, dog flu to come!" Pigs dirty.....but
dogs dirty also. Tawbah, astagfirullah!
O People! Leave dirty life and dirty principles for your civilization. Come and accept to be clean servants for
your Creator. If not, so many things coming that every injection, if dog's flu coming, no any injection to save
people. No, only they should say, "We must kill dogs or we can't be able to stop this." Our ancestors, Allah
blessing them, they were sending such a dogs into an island and they are living there, they are happy and

passing away. But now sometimes government shooting them. It is not true. No, take them a far distance and
leave them there. They may be happy there hunting with other creatures.
O People! There are two kinds of servants: good servants and bad servants. Try to be written your name on
the list of good servants, don't leave to be written your name under bad servants table. May Allah forgive us.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)
Dome dome dome dome 4x
Fatihah.
Music for you. (Mawlana smiles.) As-salamu `alaykum!
